steps.text: 分析 这是无穷和形式的极限，需要缩项. 缩项就需要讨论 $n$ 的奇、偶，故需要求子列 $\{x_{2n}\}$ 与 $\{x_{2n+1}\}$ 的极限.

\begin{array}{r l} x _ {2 n} & = \frac {1}{2 n} \cdot | 1 - 2 + 3 - \dots + (2 n - 1) - 2 n | \\ & = \frac {1}{2 n} \cdot | (1 + 3 + \dots + (2 n - 1)) - (2 + 4 + \dots + 2 n) | = \frac {1}{2 n} \cdot | n ^ {2} - (n ^ {2} + n) | = \frac {1}{2}, \end{array}

\begin{array}{r l} x _ {2 n + 1} & = \frac {1}{2 n + 1} \cdot \left| 1 - 2 + 3 - \dots - 2 n + (2 n + 1) \right| \\ & = \frac {1}{2 n + 1} \cdot \left| (1 + 3 + \dots + (2 n + 1)) - (2 + 4 + \dots + 2 n) \right| \\ & = \frac {1}{2 n + 1} \cdot \left| (n ^ {2} + 2 n + 1) - (n ^ {2} + n) \right| = \frac {n + 1}{2 n + 1}. \end{array}

cdps.expected: 通常先证极限存在，再对递推式两端取极限求值。
